overview: Channel View Hotel stands in a raised clifftop position on Hope Road, looking over Shanklin Bay. It has over 50 en-suite rooms, a restaurant, a bar with regular live music, and an indoor heated pool with a spa bath and sauna. The beach and esplanade are a short walk down from the hotel.
surfTripFit: Close to the beach with an indoor pool and sauna for warming up, packed lunches, and free parking.
